faq.title: FAQ
faq.whoUsesAnswer: Graduate students, PhD candidates, and researchers who need real citations fast.
faq.citationsIncludedAnswer: Yes — pulled from real academic databases like Crossref and OpenAlex as you write.
faq.doesInventAnswer: Never. Every source is verifiable. No hallucinations, no fake DOIs.
faq.similarityCheckedAnswer: Akowe checks your text against Crossref and arXiv academic databases to surface uncited sources, flag suspicious phrases, and verify your DOIs. It is not a replacement for tools like Turnitin, which compare against a repository of submitted student papers — but it catches issues early so you can fix them before submission.
